basics.description:
**Bring Instagram Direct messages into Dynamics 365.** This short, guided form sets everything up for you. You'll paste a few values that you copy from Meta and Dynamics 365 — no coding required.

Not sure where to get a value? Every step has a link to a step-by-step guide.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: The part of the world where your service runs. Pick the one closest to your support agents.

options.text: To finish this form you'll need 4 values from Meta (Instagram) and 1 value from Dynamics 365. Have them ready and this takes about 3 minutes. If you don't have them yet, open the guides below first — then come back to this tab.
Step-by-step guide to get your Instagram (Meta) values — about 10 minutes the first time.
Step-by-step guide to get your Dynamics 365 value (the Direct Line secret).
Your checklist: (1) Instagram account ID  (2) Meta App Secret  (3) Instagram access token  (4) A webhook verify token — we make one up for you  (5) Dynamics 365 Direct Line secret
Paste the values from your Meta app below. Copy them exactly — no extra spaces.

link.label: Where do I find these? Open the Meta guide

elements.name: instagramAccountId
elements.label: Instagram account ID
elements.toolTip: A long number that identifies your Instagram professional account. In the Meta app: Instagram product > API setup page.

validations.message: This should be just numbers (no letters or spaces). Copy it from the Meta app's Instagram API setup page.

elements.name: instagramAppSecret
elements.toolTip: In the Meta app: Settings > Basic > App Secret (click Show). This stays private — we store it securely and it's never shown again.

elements.name: instagramAccessToken
elements.toolTip: The long-lived Instagram access token from the Meta guide. It lets the service send replies on your behalf.

options.text: The webhook verify token below is a password you make up. We've filled one in for you — keep it or change it. Important: you'll paste this exact same value into Meta later, so it's shown here (not hidden) on purpose.

elements.name: instagramVerifyToken
elements.label: Webhook verify token
elements.toolTip: Any word or phrase you choose. You'll type the SAME value into Meta when you set up the webhook, so it's kept visible here so you can copy it.

validations.message: Use 6-64 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores (no spaces). The default is fine to keep.

options.text: Paste the one value from Dynamics 365 below — the Direct Line secret from the custom messaging channel you created.

link.label: Where do I find this? Open the Dynamics 365 guide

elements.name: directLineSecret
elements.toolTip: From the Omnichannel / Copilot Service admin center: the custom messaging (Direct Line) channel you created > its secret or key. This is what connects Instagram chats to your agents.

options.text: Most people can skip this tab — just click Next. Only change these if you know you need to.

elements.name: appName
elements.label: Service name
elements.toolTip: A name for the service in Azure. The default works fine. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.

validations.message: 3-24 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.

elements.name: containerImage
elements.label: Container image
elements.toolTip: The prebuilt program that runs the connector. Leave this exactly as-is unless you publish your own build.
